description: Remake layer: where the Nintendo Switch remake differs from the base OoT world. Each rule replaces the base rule of the location; each move puts a location in another region. Found in game or by the audit (python -m oot_rando audit).

Links Pocket.why: The base world hands the Link's Pocket reward out at the start; the remake gives it through Rauru only after the first Master Sword pull (11/10: an Ocarina placed there was counted in sphere 0).

LW Gift from Saria.why: Saria's bridge gift is only proven after the Deku Tree (the only vanilla way out of the forest); with the forest opened early the cutscene trigger is not validated in game.

LW Near Shortcuts Grotto Chest.why: The only Lost Woods chest (purple rupee) is not in a grotto: it stands on a ledge of the stick-scrub room that only the adult bean platform of the soil near the bridge reaches (Obj_SmallFarm_A_03 → DestinationAnchor at 2.9 m).

Market Lost Dog.rule: is_child and at_night and 'Kakariko Village Gate Open'
Market Lost Dog.why: Richard only runs away once the Kakariko gate guard has read Zelda's Letter (Logic/Market_Child_Prefab_f3a2: RunningRichard needs Npc_Hylia_Soldier_003_GateOpen); before that he stays home with his owner (14/11, Discord report).

Song from Malon.rule: is_child and (Zeldas_Letter or skip_child_zelda) and Ocarina and at_day
Song from Malon.why: Malon and Talon are back at Lon Lon Ranch once Talon was woken at the castle (Entry_LonLonRanch: Goto_HyruleCastle_IsAfter_Step04_Exp), the letter is the base world's stand-in for it. With the child castle skipped (patching/child_castle_skip.py) Talon is awake from the start and the letter is shuffled.

LLR Talons Chickens.rule: is_child and at_day and (Zeldas_Letter or skip_child_zelda)
LLR Talons Chickens.why: Same as Song from Malon: Talon is at the ranch once woken at the castle, from the start with the child castle skipped.

Song from Saria.rule: is_child and 'Kakariko Village Gate Open' and at('GC Darunias Chamber', is_child)
Song from Saria.why: Saria teaches her song during the Fire Stone quest (Challenge Get_StoneOfFire, step SariaMelodyGet), only after Darunia asked for music in his chamber (11/11: Kokiri Sword behind the Skull Kid). The quest reaches Death Mountain when the Kakariko guard reads Zelda's Letter (or with the gate open from the start), not on the letter held.

Song from Ocarina of Time.why: Zelda's escape (Challenge DoorOfTime) needs Goto_HyruleCastle and Impa's send-off first. The game now starts it on the three stones held (patching/story_fixes.py), not only at the end of Dodongo's Cavern and Jabu-Jabu's Belly (15/11, Discord report).

Master Sword Pedestal.why: The Door of Time opens in the same DoorOfTime challenge, after Zelda's escape: the Song of Time alone (songs shuffled) does not open it. With the door open from the start (patching/world_openings.py) the first pull needs neither.

Gerudo Training Ground Heavy Block First.why: The chest of the first heavy block room is opened by shooting a target, not reached freely (prudence until checked in game).

GC Maze Center Chest.why: The remake keeps the silver boulder for a chest of its own: the Silver Gauntlets no longer reach the center and right chests (prudence until checked in game).

GC Maze Right Chest.why: Same as GC Maze Center Chest.

LH Sun.why: Shooting the sun from the scarecrow pillar is not counted: only after the lake refills (prudence until checked in game).

Big Poe Kill.rule: can_ride_epona and Bow and has_bottle and can_use(Hookshot)
Big Poe Kill.why: One of the Big Poe spots is only reachable with the Hookshot in the remake (prudence until checked in game).

Colossus Great Fairy Reward.why: Prudence: this Great Fairy's reward is held back until the first wallet upgrade, until her flow is checked in game.

OGC Great Fairy Reward.why: Same as Colossus Great Fairy Reward.

Sheik at Temple.why: The patched Prelude of Light trigger checks the Forest Medallion held, independently of the Forest Sage's awakening.

Sheik in Kakariko.rule: is_adult and Forest_Medallion and Fire_Medallion and Water_Medallion
Sheik in Kakariko.why: The patched burning-village condition (story_fixes.kakariko_burning_on_medallions) checks the Forest, Fire and Water Medallions held, independently of the sages' awakening.

ToT Light Arrows Cutscene.why: The patched adult Temple of Time trigger checks the Shadow and Spirit Medallions held, independently of the sages' awakening scenes.

Song from Malon.rule: is_child and 'Met Zelda' and Ocarina and at_day
Song from Malon.why: The base rule uses Zelda's Letter as the sign that Zelda was met. The remake reads the castle quest, never the letter item (only the Kakariko guard does), so the letter can leave the pool with the gate open.

LLR Talons Chickens.why: Talon's cucco game depends on the castle quest (Minigame_FindOutCucco: Goto_HyruleCastle past Step03_02), not on Zelda's Letter held.

Lost Woods -> Zora River.why: A closed Kokiri Forest only blocks the bridge to Hyrule Field (its guard and invisible wall): the Lost Woods underwater shortcut to Zora's River stays open in the remake, so AP's can_leave_forest is dropped. From the river Hyrule Field is always reached (ZR Front).

GC Woods Warp -> Goron City.why: A closed Kokiri Forest does not block the Lost Woods shortcut to Goron City once its rock is broken (bombs, Din's Fire): AP's can_leave_forest is dropped. Kakariko stays behind its gate (Kak Behind Gate -> Kakariko Village still needs the gate open for child Link).

Death Mountain Summit -> DMC Upper Local.why: Child Death Mountain Crater actors are excluded from the shuffle and logic; only the adult crater is considered.

Bolero of Fire Warp -> DMC Central Local.why: The warp must not reintroduce excluded child crater checks or child bean planting into the logic.

Root -> HC Garden Locations.why: Child Hyrule Castle skipped (patching/child_castle_skip.py): Zelda and Impa are met from the start ('Met Zelda'), their checks hold green rupees.

ZR Front -> Zora River.why: The remake does not let adult Link hop past the boulder at the river mouth: it must be blown up or smashed. The seed now removes the river mouth air walls for both ages (story_fixes.zora_river_wall_edits, zora_river_child_wall_edits); this rule stays until Link is seen passing over the fence in game, then AP's 'is_adult or has_explosives' can come back.

Market Back Alley -> Market Bombchu Shop.why: The Bombchu Shop only opens once King Dodongo is beaten (prudence until checked in game).

Lake Hylia -> Water Temple Lobby.rule: is_adult and Hookshot and (Iron_Boots or (Longshot and (Progressive_Scale, 2) and 'King Zora Thawed'))
Lake Hylia -> Water Temple Lobby.why: The gate switch of the lake (HyruleField_LakeHylia_Common_Prefab_6a9d) only reacts while the Iron Boots are worn. Without them the gate only opens by itself once SageOfWater reaches Step05 (King Zora thawed, or the Serenade in the Ice Cavern): diving with the Golden Scale is not enough before that.

SFM Entryway -> SFM Wolfos Grotto.why: The remake hides the Wolfos grotto under a cover the Song of Storms lifts (Discord 16/11), not under a bombable rock as in the base world.

Met Zelda.why: Zelda in the castle garden completes Goto_HyruleCastle, which starts DoorOfTime; Impa's send-off follows.

Cojiro Access.rule: is_adult and at_day and 'Wake Up Adult Talon'
Cojiro Access.why: Talon's brother only hands over Cojiro by day.

Dodongos Cavern Clear.rule: ((can_use(Megaton_Hammer) and logic_dc_hammer_floor) or has_explosives or king_dodongo_shortcuts) and (((Bombs or Progressive_Strength_Upgrade) and can_jumpslash) or deadly_bonks == 'ohko')
Dodongos Cavern Clear.why: King Dodongo beaten (same rule as his reward), for the story steps that follow the boss and not the Goron Ruby held.

Forest Temple Clear.rule: can_use(Hookshot) or can_use(Bow) or (can_use(Slingshot) and Kokiri_Sword)
Forest Temple Clear.why: Phantom Ganon beaten: the Forest Sage awakens.

Fire Temple Clear.why: Volvagia beaten: the Fire Sage awakens.

Shadow Temple Clear.rule: (Kokiri_Sword or is_adult) and (can_use(Hookshot) or can_use(Bow) or can_use(Slingshot) or logic_shadow_bongo) and (can_use(Lens_of_Truth) or logic_lens_bongo)
Shadow Temple Clear.why: Bongo Bongo beaten: the Shadow Sage awakens.

Spirit Temple Clear.why: Twinrova beaten: the Spirit Sage awakens.

Kak Windmill Heart Piece.why: Kak_heart_piece_2, the windmill heart piece (1.5, 108.9, 37.5): reached as adult with the Hookshot (Discord report, 17/11). Matched by item with the Impa's house one, it had the conjunction of both AP rules.

Kak Impas House Heart Piece.why: Kak_heart_piece_1, the heart piece in the cow cage behind Impa's house (-44, 108, 112): the AP Impa's house freestanding heart piece, no longer tied to the windmill one.

GC Lower Ledge Chests.why: Goron City chests of the remake (6 where AP has 3), checked in game by Robophill (Discord 16/11): GC_chest_1 and 2, past the sign-cutting puzzle, are only reached with the Hookshot.

GC Hammer Rock Chest.why: Goron City chests of the remake (6 where AP has 3), checked in game by Robophill (Discord 16/11): GC_chest_3 sits behind a rock only the Megaton Hammer breaks.

GC Maze Rocks.why: Goron City chests of the remake (6 where AP has 3), checked in game by Robophill (Discord 16/11): GC_chest_4 and 5, behind the maze rocks, are the only chests a child reaches (AP maze center rule).

GC Silver Rock Chest.why: Goron City chests of the remake (6 where AP has 3), checked in game by Robophill (Discord 16/11): GC_chest_6 sits behind the silver boulder (Necro 16/11: the Kokiri Emerald there was given with bombs only).

Skull Mask.rule: 'Kakariko Village Gate Open' and (complete_mask_quest or at('Kakariko Village', is_child))
Skull Mask.why: The mask shop opens on the Kakariko gate flag (Npc_Hylia_Soldier_003_GateOpen in Market_Child modules and DisplayShop), not on Zelda's Letter held.

DMT Great Fairy Reward.why: The remake swaps two fountains: the Death Mountain Trail fairy plays Dm_FairyFountain_Din (map icon HavePlayedEvent.Dm_FairyFountain_Din), not the magic meter.

HC Great Fairy Reward.why: Same swap: the Hyrule Castle fairy plays Dm_FairyFountain_Power (magic meter), not Din's Fire.

LW Near Shortcuts Grotto Chest.why: Same chest: on a ledge of the Lost Woods, not in the grotto.
